# Koivu Labs

> A Finnish software studio. Websites and AI integrations for Finnish businesses — real tools, built for real clients.

Koivu Labs is an independent software studio founded in 2026 in Saarijärvi, Finland. The studio designs and builds websites, web applications and AI integrations with a pragmatic, no-hype approach.

## Studio

- **Founded:** 2026
- **Location:** Saarijärvi, Finland
- **Philosophy:** Pragmatic Intelligence — Nordic precision meets modern AI capability
- **Contact:** hello@koivulabs.com

## Services

- **Build** — Websites, web applications and internal tools. Designed, built and deployed end to end. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Tailwind CSS, Vercel.
- **Consult** — Digital strategy and AI integration for businesses. Concrete recommendations, technical audits, hands-on implementation support.
- **Experiment** — Rapid prototyping to validate ideas before committing to them.

## Client Work

- **Mystical La Luna** — Brand-crafted website for a mystical lifestyle business. Design, build, hosting. (2026)
- **Karhun Kattila** — Website for an artisan food brand rooted in Finnish tradition. Design, content structure, SEO foundation. (2026)
